name: smwmusic-gunstar-heroes-the-ancient-ruins
title: Gunstar Heroes - The Ancient Ruins
description:
An intense song for athletic or probably futuristic themes. Most instruments are vanilla except the bass and percussions which are actually from genesis.

Note that due to the size of samples, the song doesn't contain the sample of explosion which is used by a lightning or blargg. In levels using this song, their SFX will sound weird.
